description: Late letter in a cursive script, very faded with extensive liquid damage. The address lists the recipient as the sender's father: wālidī Ḥ... .... Shoshān. The name Yosef Shoshān also appears in the body of the letter, perhaps at the opening of a section, but the text is quite damaged. Lines 5 and 6 on the verso image mention Ereṣ Yisraʾel.
description_he: מכתב מאוחר דהוי מאוד בכתב קורסיבי.
